## Goal

Ship the approved homepage structure from the brief: nav, short hero, public record summary, real chart, latest settled analyses, sample of real content, subscription explanation, pricing, methodology, FAQ, footer with operator.

## Context

Main message: "Výsledky neschováváme. Ani ty špatné." Data comes from existing loaders (`src/lib/tips/loader.ts`, `publicTrackRecord`).

## Scope

- Implement sections per `docs/DESIGN.md` rules 38 to 65.
- Pricing section without buy button in Phase A.
- Empty states for every data section.

## Out of scope

- History page redesign.

- [ ] Every number on the page comes from the database (reviewer checks).
- [ ] Works at 320 px without horizontal scroll.
- [ ] axe: zero serious/critical.
- [ ] LCP <= 2.5 s and CLS <= 0.1 on a mobile Lighthouse run against a production build.
